meta.name: graph
meta.description: Use when the user wants to build, refresh, or visualize the repo's knowledge graph — code structure plus the committed wiki/ — via graphify. Produces an interactive graph + a GRAPH_REPORT.md of God Nodes, surprising connections, and suggested questions. Trigger on "/graph", "build the knowledge graph", "graph the repo", "map the codebase", "refresh the graph", "visualize the second brain".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码仓库结构变成可交互的知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要理解大型代码库的结构和关联
copy.tagline_en: Turn your codebase into an interactive knowledge graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to understand the structure and connections of a large codebase

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以构建并展示当前仓库的知识图谱，包括代码结构和已提交的 wiki 笔记。它会生成一个交互式 HTML 图谱和一份 GRAPH_REPORT.md 报告，列出核心节点、意外连接和建议问题。
howto.when: 当用户要求“构建知识图谱”、“映射代码库”或“刷新图谱”时触发。也适合在重大结构变更后或重构前使用。

say.text: 构建这个仓库的知识图谱。
say.note: Claude 会运行 graphify 生成图谱和报告。

say.text: 刷新知识图谱，看看最近改动后的结构。
say.note: Claude 会执行快速代码刷新。

say.text: 用 /graph-query 查询图谱中两个模块的关系。
say.note: Claude 会引导你使用查询功能。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can build and display a knowledge graph of the current repository, including code structure and committed wiki notes. It produces an interactive HTML graph and a GRAPH_REPORT.md listing God Nodes, surprising connections, and suggested questions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to "build the knowledge graph", "map the codebase", or "refresh the graph". Also suitable after significant structural changes or before refactoring.

say_en.text: Build the knowledge graph for this repo.
say_en.note: Claude runs graphify to generate the graph and report.

say_en.text: Refresh the knowledge graph to see recent changes.
say_en.note: Claude performs a fast code-only refresh.

say_en.text: Use /graph-query to explore relationships between two modules.
say_en.note: Claude guides you to use the query feature.
